title: A repository's host and its OWNER/NAME are split inline beside release_repo_host: release_run_artifacts, default_tap, the candidate pick and the cut's refusal
body:
Found by CRITIC-4 on ST0011 WP02b-1 (its W2): release_run_artifacts (lib/release.steps) and default_tap (lib/cmd/formula) split HOST/OWNER/NAME inline beside release_repo_host, and release_candidate_pick and cut_run's pre-flight refusal each take OWNER/NAME inline; fix: both ask release_repo_host, and one helper gives OWNER/NAME to all four. After the release, no work before it.

Resolution (cc, 2026-11-05 04:42Z by date -u): fixed at 4a399e2b521711ae20e264c6be7687c7d54f6e14, landed on main by devbin-vc's land-stack.sh as the first of group A's train 1 (0308, 0309, 0312), its paths equal to the tested stack commit's, unpushed until the 0.1.20 cut. release_repo_split, in lib/release.steps, is now the one split of a repository into its host and its OWNER/NAME, and the one reading of whether it names a host: release_repo_host and release_repo_path each read a field of it, the host falling back to github.com, and default_tap, release_candidate_pick, cut_run's refusal of remotes on more than one other host and release_run_artifacts all read it, with no behaviour change. A new releasecore.bats arm reads the split and both helpers over OWNER/NAME, github.com/OWNER/NAME and HOST/OWNER/NAME, in lower and mixed case. Train 1's run on pplr-vc's desk, at e7133d13 in slot 01M6M084QB56E66T6M067SEX8A on 2026-11-04, was stopped at hv's word before its GNU legs ended, and the unit lands on its record under hv's rule of 2026-11-05. The arm was red at its red clone, the base with the unit's test, on the helper's absence. At the tip under BSD, releasecore, releasecut, releaseattach, releasepublish, formula, ci-state, releaselegs, releasestatus, releasesnapshot and contract were green, and release.bats read 73 of 74, its one red at :480 the base's stale views, which main regenerated at 1c291303. Of the 21 GNU legs, 19 had ended, each green but that same red. The GNU legs, the tree scans, the whole suite and one critic pass run once, after every issue is closed. critic-shell reviewed the unit once before the run, and every finding was settled.
